<!--
Data-driven progress report. Replaces last term's hand-typed tracker.
Inputs:
  - tracking/students.csv    (roster: student_id, github_username, section, ...)
  - tracking/attendance.csv  (the only manual datum: github_username, week, present)
  - homework status          (AUTO-derived from the org by automation/tracking.ps1 -> hw_status.csv)
Render:  quarto render tracking/progress.qmd
-->

```{r config}
library(tidyverse)

# --- pass thresholds (edit here only) ---
N_SESSIONS      <- 13
N_HOMEWORKS     <- 10
MIN_ATTENDANCE  <- ceiling(0.80 * N_SESSIONS)   # e.g. 11/13
MIN_HOMEWORK    <- ceiling(0.80 * N_HOMEWORKS)  # e.g. 8/10

root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("CLAUDE.md"))
read_local <- function(base) {
  # prefer the git-ignored *.local.csv (real data) if present, else the committed template
  local <- file.path(root, "tracking", paste0(base, ".local.csv"))
  path  <- if (file.exists(local)) local else file.path(root, "tracking", paste0(base, ".csv"))
  readr::read_csv(path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)
}
```

```{r load}
students   <- read_local("students")
attendance <- read_local("attendance")

# Homework status produced by: ./automation/tracking.ps1  (writes tracking/hw_status.csv)
hw_path <- file.path(root, "tracking", "hw_status.csv")
hw <- if (file.exists(hw_path)) {
  readr::read_csv(hw_path, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)   # github_username, week, submitted
} else {
  tibble(github_username = character(), week = integer(), submitted = integer())
}
```

```{r summarise}
att_by_student <- attendance |>
  filter(present == 1) |>
  distinct(github_username, week) |>
  count(github_username, name = "attended")

hw_by_student <- hw |>
  filter(submitted == 1) |>
  distinct(github_username, week) |>
  count(github_username, name = "homeworks")

progress <- students |>
  select(github_username, section) |>
  left_join(att_by_student, by = "github_username") |>
  left_join(hw_by_student,  by = "github_username") |>
  mutate(
    attended   = coalesce(attended, 0L),
    homeworks  = coalesce(homeworks, 0L),
    pass_att   = attended  >= MIN_ATTENDANCE,
    pass_hw    = homeworks >= MIN_HOMEWORK,
    on_track   = pass_att & pass_hw
  )
```

```{r table}
progress |>
  arrange(desc(on_track), github_username) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("GitHub", "Section", "Attended", "Homeworks", "Att ok", "HW ok", "On track"),
    caption = sprintf("Thresholds: attendance ≥ %d/%d, homework ≥ %d/%d.",
                      MIN_ATTENDANCE, N_SESSIONS, MIN_HOMEWORK, N_HOMEWORKS)
  )
```

Homework completion is derived automatically from submission repos on the org — nothing is typed
by hand except attendance.
